resources.string: Showing subtitles over the TV\'s HDMI picture
CouchSubs subtitles stopped. Open CouchSubs again to turn them back on.
Overlay mode: subtitles appear over the TV\'s own HDMI picture.
No picture inside CouchSubs. Switching to overlay mode: subtitles appear over the TV\'s own HDMI picture.
Switch the TV to the PS5\'s input (HDMI %1$d) with the remote. Subtitles will appear on top.
Overlay mode needs the \"Display over other apps\" permission.
The PS5 picture is not coming through inside CouchSubs. On some TVs it stays black here; overlay mode fixes this, but it needs the \"Display over other apps\" permission.

The PS5 picture is not coming through inside CouchSubs. On some TVs it stays black here. Overlay mode fixes this, but it is only in the TV app that CouchSubs on your computer installs: uninstall this copy, turn on USB debugging on the TV and start the translation on your computer.

CouchSubs on your computer grants it when it installs the TV app: start the translation there with USB debugging on. Or on the TV open Settings › Apps › Special app access › Display over other apps and turn on CouchSubs.
Choose the HDMI input your PS5 is connected to (arrow keys and OK, or number keys 1–4):

Still black on the right input? This TV may not hand its HDMI picture to apps (some Vestel and MediaTek TVs), or HDCP blocks it. Try turning off Settings › System › HDMI › Enable HDCP on the PS5. Otherwise switch the TV to the PS5\'s HDMI input with the remote and read the subtitles on your phone.
This TV does not let apps show its HDMI inputs, so the PS5 picture cannot appear inside CouchSubs. Switch the TV to the PS5\'s HDMI input with the remote and read the subtitles on your phone.
The TV app installed by CouchSubs on a computer has overlay mode: subtitles appear over the TV\'s own HDMI picture.
